# =====================================================================
# workflow-placeholder.yaml — DRAFT / INCOMPLETE — DO NOT EXECUTE
# =====================================================================
# Status:    PLACEHOLDER. Committed before the real workflow definition
#            was provided. The process steps, systems, roles, decision
#            rules, payment terms and exception paths are UNKNOWN.
# Usage:     Fill every <placeholder> from the missing-details checklist,
#            then remove this header once reviewed and complete.
# Note:      Engine-agnostic skeleton; converts 1:1 to BPMN elements
#            (trigger -> start event, steps -> tasks, decisions ->
#            gateways, timers -> boundary events) if made executable.
# =====================================================================

workflow:
  id: <workflow-id>
  name: <human-readable-name>
  version: 0.1.0-draft
  engine: <camunda-7 | camunda-8 | none>      # or drop key if engine-agnostic

  trigger:
    type: <message | timer | manual | event>
    source: <system-or-channel-that-starts-it>

  variables:                                   # data carried through the flow
    - name: <variable-name>
      type: <string | number | boolean | object>

  steps:                                       # ordered sequence of work
    - id: step-1
      name: <step-name>
      actor: <role-or-system>                  # e.g. sales-rep, erp-bot
      system: <system-of-record>               # e.g. SAP, Salesforce; omit if manual
      action: <what-happens>
      on_error: <retry | skip | escalate | halt>

  decisions:                                   # branch points, referenced by step id
    - id: decision-1
      after_step: <step-id>
      question: <decision-to-evaluate>         # e.g. credit-approved?
      branches:
        - when: <condition>
          goto: <step-id-or-end-state>

  timers:                                      # SLAs / dunning
    - on_step: <step-id>
      after: <duration, e.g. P30D>
      then: <step-id-or-action>

  exceptions:                                  # cancellation / return / dispute paths
    - id: <exception-id>
      trigger: <event-or-condition>
      goto: <cleanup-step-id>

  end_states:
    - <success-state>
    - <failure-state>
